alsoFrom.note: The landing and editorial register: display serif, eyebrow, pull line, landing grid, panel card, how-it-works steps, brand, theme button, screen-wide.

alsoFromPortfolio.note: Entry list, section heading, stat line, timeline, meter, Commit Mono, reading width and the knowledge colours. Restyled onto the kit's tokens; values left as the portfolio has them where the kit had none.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (body). Daylight paper / ink ground.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Cards, concept panels, toasts and text inputs: anything that sits above the page.

tokens.name: surface-recessed
tokens.usage: Inset areas below the page: concept asides, prose code blocks, table headers, front-matter lists.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface, surface-elevated and surface-recessed: 13:1 or more in Daylight and Ink, 15:1 or more in High contrast.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Lead paragraphs, form labels, chunk bodies, blockquotes and pending messages on any surface: 6.2:1 or more; 10:1 or more in High contrast.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Small mono labels, meta lines, the topbar and inactive phase names. Clears 4.5:1 on surface and surface-elevated in Daylight (5.1, 5.4) and Ink (6.2, 5.6), 9:1 or more in High contrast. The lighter #8a8474 it replaced measured about 2.2:1. Re-check any replacement against both surfaces in every theme.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card, input and ghost-button outlines; phase bars not yet reached; meta separators. Daylight and Ink are decorative strength (1.2:1 on surface), so a control there must be findable by label and position. High contrast #7a7466 holds 3.9:1 or more on every surface, so outlines alone delimit controls.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines: hr, empty-state rules, prose table cells, the pending track. In High contrast, 3:1 or more like every other line.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Text selection highlight (::selection).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Sage. The one primary action colour: filled buttons, links, the focus ring, the current phase and the pending line. 5.2:1 or more on every surface in Daylight and Ink; a deeper sage at 8.4:1 or more in High contrast.

tokens.name: accent-contrast
tokens.usage: Text drawn on accent (primary button label): 6.1:1 Daylight, 8.4:1 Ink (flips to dark ink because the accent lightens), 10:1 High contrast.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The pressed checkpoint option's fill.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Completed phase bars; the undo button and pressed checkpoint border. 4.1:1 or more on every surface in High contrast.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution marks. Daylight #b5722a is 3.5:1 on surface (kept exact: it is the pod family's brand value): fine for icons, borders and text 24px or larger, NOT body-size text. For caution text people must read, the High contrast theme's #6e4210 holds 8.2:1.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a caution notice.

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of a caution notice. 3.8:1 or more in High contrast.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: The error detail line (.error) and nothing larger. 5.6:1 or more on danger-soft in Daylight and Ink, 8.9:1 in High contrast.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: The fill behind the one-line error detail. Never a whole panel: an expired token is not an alarm.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Inline code and the technical disclosure in an error state.

tokens.name: know-block
tokens.usage: A knowledge block: neutral, raw material. The portfolio's block dot. 10:1 or more on surface in both themes. From the portfolio's knowledge semantics; app-specific meaning, kept here so there is one source.

tokens.name: know-convergence
tokens.usage: A convergence moment, where an old idea meets new work. Amber, close to warn: never put the two side by side. 5:1 or more on surface. From the portfolio's knowledge semantics; app-specific meaning, kept here so there is one source.

tokens.name: know-pattern
tokens.usage: An extracted skill pattern (a highlighted subgraph). Coral, close to danger: in the knowledge views only, never next to an error. 4.9:1 or more on surface. From the portfolio's knowledge semantics; app-specific meaning, kept here so there is one source.

tokens.name: know-temporal
tokens.usage: Time markers: timeline dots, dates that carry meaning. 5.9:1 or more on surface. From the portfolio's knowledge semantics; app-specific meaning, kept here so there is one source.

tokens.name: know-frontier
tokens.usage: Fog of war: the unexplored, the not yet. About 2:1 on surface: dots, lines and fills only, never text. From the portfolio's knowledge semantics; app-specific meaning, kept here so there is one source.

tokens.name: know-fresh
tokens.usage: A new capture, a fresh ingestion, a strong signal. 7:1 or more on surface. From the portfolio's knowledge semantics; app-specific meaning, kept here so there is one source.

tokens.name: meter-fill
tokens.usage: A meter's fill (.meter). Sage by default; an app may set --meter-fill to a knowledge colour (the portfolio's confidence thresholds: fresh 85%+, convergence 70–84%, temporal below).

families.heading: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: "Commit Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Newsreader, regular 400 and italic only (OFL, self-hosted from @fontsource/newsreader 5.3.0, latin subset). Never bold: the serif carries the voice by size, not weight. Georgia while it loads. The landing sizes are fluid in CSS (clamp); the size shown is the ceiling.

styles.name: landing-title
styles.usage: The landing's one h1 (.display.landing-title): clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem), text-wrap: balance. Once per site.
styles.sample: Your pod, and the collectives you belong to.

styles.name: display-serif
styles.usage: A view's title on wide screens (.display): clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 3rem).

styles.name: landing-h2
styles.usage: A landing band's title (.display.landing-h2): clamp(1.75rem, 4vw, 2.5rem), balanced.
styles.sample: Work together, without a platform in the middle.

styles.name: entry-title
styles.usage: An entry's title in a list (.entry-title): a post, a document, a project. The serif at 20px, as the portfolio's list sets it, at regular weight.
styles.sample: A fresh perspective on Open Value Networks

styles.name: step-title
styles.usage: A numbered step's title (.display.how-title): the serif at h3 size.

styles.name: pull
styles.usage: The italic line under a display title or between leads (.pull), in text-primary. One per section, one sentence.
styles.sample: Who you are, who may read what, and who you work with.

groups.name: Headings

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero, the largest text on a screen. Rare.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title; receives focus on every screen change.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title and the title of every pattern (concept, checkpoint, empty and error states).

groups.note: Headings carry no explicit weight in the source, so they render at the browser default bold (700).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text; paragraphs cap at measure-body (65ch).
styles.sample: A pod is a locker on the web that only you hold the key to.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary body: chunk bodies, toast messages, prose code.
styles.sample: Sharing is handing out copies of the key.

styles.name: chunk-title
styles.usage: Concept chunk title and the current phase name.

styles.name: landing-lead
styles.usage: The hero's lead (.lead.landing-lead), text-secondary, capped at 34em.
styles.sample: A pod is an online space that belongs to you.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Help text under a field and the quiet line under a form (.hint), in text-secondary, in the body family. Prose someone reads, so never mono; mono stays for the address inside it.
styles.sample: Your pod's address, or your WebID if you don't know which provider hosts it.

groups.name: Labels

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, the topbar, in text-tertiary (.meta).

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a pattern title (.label-mono), in text-tertiary.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The landing's kicker (.eyebrow): uppercase mono in text-tertiary, twice label-mono's tracking, led by a 40px rule in currentColor at 0.6 opacity. Above a display title; label-mono stays the in-app kicker.

groups.note: Commit Mono (OFL, self-hosted from @fontsource/commit-mono 5.3.0, latin 400 and 700): even widths for metadata, paths and WebIDs. System monospace while it loads.

spacing.note: Universal 4px base unit (core.css). Density (page and card padding) is a theme decision; core only supplies the raw scale.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Phase bar height; toast button vertical padding; front-matter row gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label-to-input gap, checkpoint option gap, topbar padding, meta separator margins.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button vertical padding, phase rail gap, error/empty state gaps, concept aside padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, stack gap, concept chunk gap, toast horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Concept card padding; error state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen top and bottom padding (plus safe-area insets); empty state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Large section separation.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large section separation.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page-level separation.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Page-level separation; largest step.

radius.note: Max 4px on rectangular elements, except radius-mark (6px) on the brand mark; radius-full only for circular or pill marks.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Flush edges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Error detail, concept aside, code blocks, front-matter list.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, concept cards, toasts. The largest radius a rectangle gets.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: The brand mark beside an app's name (.brand-mark), and nothing else: the one rectangle allowed above 4px, kept from the backoffice so the small mark reads soft at 22px.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dots, avatars, status indicators, phase bars and the pending line.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Every outline and hairline.

tokens.name: measure-body
tokens.usage: Max width of paragraphs, leads, chunk bodies and the pending track.

tokens.name: width-app
tokens.usage: The app column (.screen): one column, mobile-first.

tokens.name: width-reading
tokens.usage: Reading pages (.reading): an article, a list of entries, a timeline. The portfolio's column, with a space-8 gutter.

tokens.name: width-landing
tokens.usage: The landing's frame (.landing), with a space-8 gutter (space-4 under 40rem).

tokens.name: width-wide
tokens.usage: Wide app screens (.screen-wide): lists beside a detail, the profile beside its source.

tokens.name: measure-lead
tokens.usage: The landing lead's line length.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: An article's running text in a reading page.
